title: AWS Knowledge Base Retrieval MCP Server
excerpt: AWS Knowledge Base Retrieval MCP Server An MCP server implementation for retrieving information from the AWS Knowledge Base using the Bedrock Agent Runtime. Features RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) : Retrieve context from the AWS Knowledge Base based on a query and a Knowledge Base ID. Supports multiple results retrieval : Option to retrieve a customizable number of results. Tools retrieve from aws kb Perform retrieval operations using the AWS Knowledge Base.
